criteria.requirement: Add evolve_as(instance, target_class, **changes) in attr.evolution and attrs.evolution. Copy common init=True fields by their real attribute names into the target initialization aliases, with explicit target-alias changes winning. Use the target standard constructor so its converters, defaults/factories, validators and post-init execute normally. Do not copy init=False hidden state, mutate the source or deep-copy existing payloads. Reject unknown target aliases, alias conflicts, non-attrs types and unrelated targets with no common init fields; leave missing required arguments and target validation errors explicit. Preserve ordinary attrs.evolve.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
